summary_zh: NeuroNirvamanEA 2是一个基于神经网络的智能交易系统，利用机器学习概念预测市场方向并生成交易信号。该EA可能采用训练过或自适应的神经模型来分类市场状况并自动执行交易。'2'后缀表明这是改进后的第二版，在架构或功能上比原版有所增强。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于神经网络的市场预测模型，通过输入多种技术指标或价格特征来训练模型识别交易机会。入场条件依赖于神经网络的输出信号，当模型预测上涨概率超过阈值时做多，预测下跌概率超过阈值时做空。出场条件可能结合固定止损止盈或神经网络的反向信号。仓位管理方面，由于文件为二进制格式无法确认具体逻辑，但基于神经网络的EA通常采用固定手数或基于风险百分比的仓位控制。资金管理方面，该EA可能缺乏传统的资金管理框架，过度依赖模型预测的准确性。需要注意的是，神经网络的过拟合风险较高，在训练数据上表现良好但在实盘中可能出现显著回撤。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a neural network market prediction model that takes multiple technical indicators or price features as inputs to identify trading opportunities. Entry conditions depend on the neural network output signals, going long when the model predicts an upward probability above a threshold and going short when it predicts a downward probability above a threshold. Exit conditions may combine fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels or neural network reversal signals. For position sizing, since the file is in binary format and cannot be read, the specific logic cannot be confirmed, but neural network-based EAs typically use fixed lot sizes or risk-percentage-based position control. Regarding money management, this EA may lack a traditional risk management framework, relying heavily on the accuracy of the model's predictions. It is important to note that neural networks carry a high risk of overfitting, performing well on training data but potentially experiencing significant drawdowns in live trading.
